title: Chinese (Mandarin)
description: Mandarin Chinese in simplified characters with pinyin: greetings, family, food, numbers, travel and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
tips: Mandarin has four tones, shown by marks in pinyin: mā, má, mǎ, mà. You may type pinyin without the tone marks.

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
tips: '的' (de) shows possession: 我的朋友 (wǒ de péngyou) = my friend. With close family it is often left out: 我妈妈 = my mum.

units.title: Food and drink
tips: Adjectives usually come with '很' (hěn, very): 茶很烫 (chá hěn tàng) = the tea is hot.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
tips: Put a measure word between a number and a noun: 两个孩子 (two children), 一杯咖啡 (one cup of coffee). 'Two' before a measure word is 两 (liǎng), not 二 (èr).

units.title: Travel and directions
units.description: Find your way around a new city.
tips: '在' (zài) means 'to be at': 车站在右边 (chēzhàn zài yòubian) = the station is on the right.

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.
tips: Time words come before the verb: 我早上喝咖啡 = I (in the) morning drink coffee.

units.title: Shopping
units.description: Ask for things, prices and how to pay.
tips: '太…了' (tài … le) means 'too …': 太 贵 了 (tài guì le) = too expensive.

answers: Can I pay with a card?
